description:
# Check: upstream markdown.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/markdown.test.ts

## Subject
Markdown rendering: lists, tables, code blocks, inline formatting, blockquotes, headings, links, strikethrough, HTML.

## Upstream test count (approx)
82

## Behaviors asserted upstream

Lists:
- simple nested list; deeply nested (4+ levels); ordered nested; mixed ordered/unordered; numbering maintained when code blocks are not indented (LLM output)

Tables:
- simple table; row dividers between data rows; column width at least longest word; alignment (left/center/right); varying column widths; wraps cells when table exceeds width; wraps long cell content; wraps long unbroken tokens inside cells; wraps styled inline code without breaking borders; narrow width handled; renders correctly when it fits naturally; respects paddingX in width calculation; no trailing blank line when table is last block
- lists and tables together

Spacing/styling:
- gray italic styling preserved after inline code and after bold (thinking traces)
- styles do not leak into following lines in TUI
- single blank line between code block / divider / heading / blockquote and following paragraph
- no trailing blank line when code block / divider / heading / blockquote is last

Blockquotes:
- consistent styling in lazy continuation blockquote
- consistent styling in explicit multiline blockquote
- list content inside blockquotes
- wrap long blockquote lines with border per wrapped line
- proper indent for wrapped lines with styling
- inline formatting inside blockquotes with quote styling reapplied

Headings:
- styling preserved after inline code (h1 underline no leak into padding when code is last token)
- styling preserved after bold text

Strikethrough/tilde:
- ~~text~~ as strikethrough
- ~text~ plain

Links/URLs:
- no URL duplication for autolinked emails
- no URL duplication for bare URLs
- URL in parentheses when hyperlinks not supported (including mailto)
- emits OSC 8 when terminal supports hyperlinks (mailto and bare URLs too)

HTML:
- renders content with HTML-like tags as text (not hidden)
- HTML tags in code blocks correctly

## Upstream dependencies
Markdown, resetCapabilitiesCache, setCapabilities, TUI, defaultMarkdownTheme, VirtualTerminal, Chalk

## Upstream notes
Uses VirtualTerminal. resetCapabilitiesCache() + setCapabilities() toggle hyperlink/image support. OSC 8 format: \\x1b]8;;URL\\x1b\\text\\x1b]8;;\\x1b\\. Heading h1 = bold+cyan+underline. Uses defaultMarkdownTheme fixture.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown.ex (implementation)
- look for markdown_test.exs under apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/ (grep if missing)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/support/ (theme fixtures)

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance work may be split (tables, blockquotes, inline, links). Each compliance ticket must require re-comparison and block opi-q5k.1.

comments.text:
# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/markdown.test.ts (52 tests across 13 describes)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown_test.exs (22 tests across 12 describes)

## MAPPED (partial)

| Upstream | Elixir |
|---|---|
| strikethrough `~~text~~` | "strikethrough" |
| single tilde `~text~` plain | NOT TESTED (inferred by absence) |
| basic list rendering | "renders bullet items" + "items have bullet markers" |
| basic ordered list | "renders numbered items" |
| basic blockquote | "renders with border" |
| horizontal rule | "renders as line" |
| basic links | "renders link text" + "shows URL when different from text" |
| headings h1/h2 basic | "h1 renders bold + underline + heading color" / "h2 renders bold + heading color" |
| inline formatting (bold/italic/code) | "bold text", "italic text", "code span", "mixed inline formatting" |

## UNMAPPED (substantial)

### Tables (13 tests) — our Markdown has no table implementation
grep of apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/markdown.ex returns no match for "table" or "Table". Upstream tests cover: simple tables, row dividers, alignment (left/center/right), varying column widths, cell wrapping, wrapped inline code in cells, narrow width handling, paddingX interaction, no trailing blank line when last block. **Implementation gap**.

### Nested lists (5 tests) — our lists are flat-only
- simple nested list
- deeply nested (4+ levels)
- ordered nested
- mixed ordered/unordered nested
- numbering maintained when code blocks are not indented (LLM output quirk)

### Heading with inline code (4 tests)
- preserves heading styling after inline code
- preserves h1 styling after inline code (underline + bold + cyan)
- does not leak h1 underline into padding when inline code is last token
- preserves heading styling after bold text

### Pre-styled text / thinking traces (3 tests)
Gray italic styling invariants when markdown is rendered within an already-styled context:
- gray italic preserved after inline code
- gray italic preserved after bold text
- styles do not leak into following lines in TUI

### Spacing invariants (9 tests across code/divider/heading/blockquote describes)
Each block type has: "single blank line between X and following paragraph" + "no trailing blank line when X is the last rendered block". Our "heading followed by paragraph has spacing" covers one case — the rest are gaps.

### Blockquotes with multiline content (6 tests)
- consistent styling in lazy continuation blockquote
- consistent styling in explicit multiline blockquote
- list content inside blockquotes
- wrap long blockquote lines with border per wrapped line
- proper indent for wrapped lines with styling
- inline formatting inside blockquotes with quote styling reapplied

### HTML-like tags (2 tests)
- renders content with HTML-like tags as text (not hidden)
- HTML tags in code blocks correctly

### Advanced links / OSC 8 hyperlinks (5 tests beyond basics)
- no URL duplication for autolinked emails (email detection)
- no URL duplication for bare URLs (autolink)
- URL in parentheses when hyperlinks not supported (both regular and mailto)
- emits OSC 8 when terminal supports hyperlinks (regular, mailto, bare URL — 3 sub-cases)
- works with file:// URIs

### Combined features (1)
Lists and tables together — rendered without breaking.

## Implementation gaps (not just tests)

1. **Tables** — unimplemented in Markdown component.
2. **Nested lists** — current implementation may be flat-only; verify.
3. **Pre-styling context preservation** — unclear if current Markdown tracks surrounding style state.
4. **OSC 8 hyperlinks** — our link rendering shows URL in text (test "shows URL when different from text"); does NOT check capabilities and emit OSC 8. Cross-ref opi-q5k.34 which adds capability detection.
5. **Autolink detection** — bare URLs and email addresses.

## Action

Compliance ticket: per-describe decomposition like editor.test.ts (opi-q5k.5 master). 13 describe areas require separate processing units.
